summary: This bill requires states to collect and report data on "hidden foster care arrangements" to the Secretary of Health and Human Services, who will then submit an annual report to Congress summarizing this data.

scores.thoughts: This bill aims to increase transparency and oversight of 'hidden foster care arrangements' by requiring states to report data to the Secretary of Health and Human Services. This directly relates to the administration and accountability of child welfare services, which are a component of the social safety net, without expanding or reducing overall welfare spending. The bill focuses on improving data collection and reporting within existing frameworks (parts B and E of title IV of the Social Security Act).
